svg.title: Four receipts for one release
svg.desc: A fictional release follows four checks: match the reviewed source to the built artifact; inspect the infrastructure change and its owner; inspect every intended account and Region; then test the running artifact and customer booking. A green top-level StackSet operation can still hide a failed destination. Hold and repair the first failed boundary before reopening. This is a review method, not a deployed system.
svg.text: Follow the same reviewed change all the way through.
Which commit produced this exact image?
Record the build, test and image identity.
Read the plan, change set and events.
Did every intended account and Region finish?
A green operation can hide a failed instance.
Is the new image running with usable capacity?
Confirm a known booking on each required path.
Repair the first failed boundary; check again.
Fictional review path. No deployment or customer
traffic was tested; budget overlap and cleanup.
